notes: This model predates both published Makin MIDI documents; the channel layout, controllers and all-stops-off message are assumed from the later Makin / Church Organ World manuals (2016 and 2023) and are not confirmed for this generation. Check on your organ.
Stops are sent as toggling Program Changes on channel 12, but no per-stop Program Change table is published for this model, so every stop is left unbound: use Learn every stop.

The channel of the CC11 expression message is not stated in the manual; it is assumed to be the channel of the division the pedal controls. Master volume (CC7) is assumed on channel 1. Check on your organ; channel numbers can also be changed in the organ's MIDI menu.
'Great & Pedal Combinations Coupled', 'General on Swell Toe Pistons' and similar piston/transfer controls are console functions, not stops, and are not listed.
Westmorland Custom organs were bespoke: this is one of Makin's published sample specifications (c. 2009 brochure), and an individual instrument may differ.

Stop list: https://web.archive.org/web/20091123001431/http://www.makinorgans.co.uk/files/Downloads-downloadFile-5.pdf (archived Makin 'Westmorland Custom Organs' brochure, c. 2009) p. 9 (2 manual sample specification, 18 stop)
MIDI scheme: https://www.makinorgans.co.uk/uploads/owners_manual/COWManual5_9W.pdf (Church Organ World / Makin User Manual issue 5.9W 2016, sections 8.5-8.6 MIDI Channels and Controllers, pp. 31-32)
